source_decisions: NIKL 2026-02-28 Q&A 327751 explicitly permits retained 이 after vowel-final bases (새인들/장사인들). Thus 인들 has no consonant-only rejection despite the narrower KRDict usage note. ㄴ들 consumes a written ㄴ coda on an underlying vowel-final base.

KRDict 86088 notes nominal attachment but explicitly exemplifies 가설랑은 and 살아설랑은. Preserve those examples via 어+설랑은 and the separate 어서+ㄹ랑은 path; do not silently discard the examples or generalize to every ending.
NIKL standard-language commentary lists -질랑 among the 2016 accepted forms. ㄹ랑(은) licenses 지, 고서, 어서; 설랑(은) licenses 고, 어. These are separately encoded rather than unrestricted post-ending attachment.
ㄹ랑(은) licenses reviewed inner 에/에서/서; 설랑(은) licenses 에; 을랑/일랑/에설랑 have nominal inner boundaries in this batch. More combinations require review.

ㄹ랑/을랑/일랑/설랑 plus 은 preserve both split and dictionary compound readings. Canonical ㄴ들/ㄹ랑 remain particles, distinct from the nominal plural suffix, distributive 들, conjunction 랑 and predicate endings.

metamorphic_regression.invariant: Every 은 compound and its split counterpart have identical lemma roles and remaining morphemes. Covers coda classes, foreign-script assumptions, nominalizations, endings, auxiliaries, politeness and copulas; lexical identity alternatives are preserved.
